name: My Douchey Boss Has a Gentle Twin Brother?!
source:
When Kyle gets a new job at a fashion company, he meets Vincent Zircon, who happens to be his eccentric boss. Vincent, being quite mischievous, teases the newcomer, Kyle, causing him to think that his boss is odd. One day, he bumps into his boss after work and is surprised when his superior acts kind and gentle, even offering to buy lunch for him. Kyle starts to wonder if his boss is messing with him again. But after confronting the man about his change in behavior, Kyle realizes that the kind and gentle version of Vincent is actually someone else. Someone named Vernon Zircon, Vincent's twin brother.

As Kyle gets closer to the twin brothers, he finds out that they are estranged. The two are very different individuals with different values, making it hard for them to get along. But they both have one thing in common... What will happen when they both start to develop feelings for the same person...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2582240/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
凯尔到一家时装公司上班，认识了古怪的老板文森特·锆石。爱捉弄人的文森特没少逗这个新人，令凯尔觉得老板这人实在有些怪。一天，凯尔下班后偶遇老板，对方竟然和气又体贴，甚至要请他吃午饭。凯尔不禁怀疑，老板是不是又在拿他寻开心。等他当面追问对方怎么像变了个人，才知道眼前这个温柔的“文森特”确实是另一个人——文森特的双胞胎兄弟弗农·锆石。

随着和兄弟俩越来越亲近，凯尔才发现两人关系疏远。他们性情迥异，价值观也不同，实在很难合得来。可两人偏偏有一点相同…当他们都喜欢上同一个人，又会发生什么呢…？
